• Trapianto di microbiota fecale: un nuovo approccio per ripristinare la normobiosi intestinale ed eliminare i batteri resistenti in seguito al trattamento antibiotico La tesi di dottorato comprende principalmente uno studio clinico su cani e gatti che sviluppano disbiosi intestinale come parte di una terapia antibiotica programmata. Si sta studiando se questo problema possa essere corretto somministrando trapianti di microbiota fecale (FMT). Altri ambiti di responsabilità comprendono il lavoro nella nuova unità per l'analisi del microbioma e del metaboloma (manutenzione della banca delle feci) e nel servizio di gastroenterologia. Ciò comprende la raccolta dell'anamnesi, l'esame clinico e la creazione di elenchi di problemi, nonché l'elaborazione orientata al problema (imaging incluso prelievo di campioni, endoscopia inclusa la biopsia) nonché la terapia di pazienti con malattie gastroenterologiche. Gli studenti di dottorato lavorano a stretto contatto con medici senior e sono corresponsabili del processo clinico, nonché del reclutamento dei pazienti dello studio e della raccolta dei campioni. Requisiti: Sei un veterinario autorizzato. Ti piace lavorare con le persone e gli animali e sei appassionato del tuo lavoro. Sei impegnato, resiliente e responsabile e sei caratterizzato dalla tua capacità di lavorare in gruppo, talento organizzativo, buone capacità di comunicazione e dal tuo comportamento amichevole ed empatico. La nostra offerta: Attraverso una stretta collaborazione con studenti di dottorato, offriamo formazione in gastroenterologia e medicina interna con buone opportunità di sviluppo. I dottorandi vengono istruiti nella realizzazione di uno studio scientifico di alta qualità, supportati nella valutazione e interpretazione dei propri dati, nonché nella presentazione dei risultati a conferenze internazionali e nella pubblicazione dei risultati. Gli studenti di dottorato sono integrati in un team di dipendenti impegnato e di mentalità aperta che lavora a stretto contatto con specialisti di varie altre discipline. La Clinica di Medicina dei Piccoli Animali dell'Università di Zurigo è una clinica all'avanguardia dove lavorano numerosi specialisti riconosciuti a livello internazionale. Ulteriori informazioni possono essere trovate sulla homepage: https://www.kltmed.uzh.ch/de.html La posizione può essere iniziata immediatamente, durata 24 mesi. Nonostante l’alto costo della vita in Svizzera, la retribuzione è molto alta e interessante rispetto ad altri paesi. Il salario si basa sull’approccio del FNS. Zum weiteren Aufgabengebiet gehören die Mitarbeit in der neuen Unit für Mikrobiom- und Metabolomanalyse (Betreuung der Kotbank) sowie im Gastroenterologieservice. Dazu zählen die Anamneseerhebung, klinische Untersuchung und Erstellung von Problemlisten ebenso wie die problemorientierte Aufarbeitung (Bildgebung inkl. Probenentnahmen, Endoskopie inkl. Biopsieentnahmen) sowie die Therapie von Patienten mit gastroenterologischen Erkrankungen.
Doktorand:innen arbeiten eng mit den Oberärzt:innen zusammen und sind mitverantwortlich für den klinischen Ablauf sowie die Rekrutierung von Studienpatienten und die Probengewinnung.

Anforderungen:
Sie sind approbierte Tierärztin/approbierter Tierarzt. Der Umgang mit Menschen und Tier bereitet Ihnen Freude, und Ihr Beruf begeistert Sie. Sie sind engagiert, belastbar und verantwortungsbewusst und zeichnen sich durch Teamfähigkeit, Organisationstalent, Ihre guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten und Ihr freundliches und empathisches Auftreten aus.

Unser Angebot:

Wir bieten durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit den DoktorandInnen eine Ausbildung in Gastroenterologie und Inneren Medizin mit guten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. DoktorandInnen werden angeleitet eine hochwertige wissenschaftliche Studie durchzuführen, unterstützt ihre Daten auszuwerten und zu interpretitieren, sowie auf internationalen Kongressen ihre Ergebnisse vorzustellen und die Ergebnisse zu publizieren. DoktorandInnen sind eingebettet in ein engagiertes und aufgeschlossenes Mitarbeiterteam, welches mit Spezialisten verschiedener anderer Disziplinen eng zusammenarbeitet.

Die Klinik für Kleintiermedizin Universität Zürich ist eine hochmoderne Klinik, an welcher eine große Zahl an international anerkanntem Spezialisten arbeiten. Weitere Informationen bekommen Sie über die Homepage: https://www.kltmed.uzh.ch/de.html

Stellenantritt ab sofort möglich, Dauer 24 Monate. Die Entlohnung ist trotz der hohen Lebenshaltungskosten in der Schweiz im internationalen Vergleich sehr hoch und attraktiv. Das Salär richtet sich nach dem Ansatz des SNF.

The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
The Group of Reproductive Biology of the Institute of Veterinary Anatomy, Vetsuisse Faculty, University of Zurich www.vetanat.uzh.ch is looking for a candidate for a doctoral position in the field of comparative reproductive endocrinology.

Highly motivated graduate students with vet-med degree, interested in reproductive endocrinology, are welcomed to apply for this position.

The SNSF (Swiss National Science Foundation)-funded project investigates the molecular mechanisms of hypoxia and HIF1α signaling in steroidogenic cells, with a focus on granulosa and Leydig cells.
Steroidogenesis is a tightly regulated process essential for reproductive function, and its dysregulation contributes to a range of clinical conditions affecting gonad activity. Hypoxia and HIF1α-mediated pathways have recently emerged as integral components of the signaling networks regulating steroid hormone production. Novel regulatory mechanisms described in our research group emphasize the need for further investigations into the complex role of hypoxic signaling in the steroidogenic process (for more details see: https://drive.switch.ch/index.php/s/kchZFSdzPhqHX1g).

The acquired knowledge could potentially refine current models of physiological steroidogenesis and identify molecular mechanisms involved in the pathogenesis of steroid hormone-related clinical/pathological conditions.

The opportunity to perform doctoral/PhD work, training in molecular- and cell-biology methods, dedicated international team and support of experienced young scientists, pleasant working environment in Zurich.

Anforderungen:
• Working on the research project (molecular and cell culture laboratory work), writing a dissertation

• Contribution to anatomical dissection courses for vet-med students is expected

• Good command in English, willingness to learn German (if language knowledge not yet available)

• The successful candidate will contribute to the collaborative atmosphere with good team spirit in the lab

Aufgaben: Il Gruppo di Biologia Riproduttiva dell'Istituto di Anotomia Veterinaria, Facoltà di Vetsuisse, Università di Zurigo www.vetanat.uzh.ch sta cercando un candidato per una posizione di dottorato nel campo della equiparazione riproduttiva. Studenti altamente motivati con una laurea in medicina veterinaria, interessati alla riproduzione di endocrinologia, sono invitati a presentare domanda per questa posizione. Il progetto finanziato dalla SNSF (Swiss National Science Foundation) indaga i meccanismi molecolari dell'ipossia e HIF1α segnalando in cellule steroidiche, con una particolare attenzione alle cellule di Leydig e di granulosa. La steroidigenesi è un processo strettamente regolamentato essenziale per la funzione riproduttiva, e la sua disregolazione contribuisce a una serie di condizioni cliniche che influenzano l'attività delle gonadotropine. Ipossia e HIF1α-mediato vie sono recentemente emersi come componenti integrali delle reti di segnalazione che regolano la produzione di ormoni steroidei. meccanismi di regolazione nuovi descritti nel nostro gruppo di ricerca sottolineano la necessità di ulteriori indagini sul ruolo complesso del segnale ipossico nel processo steroideogenico (per maggiori dettagli vedere: https://drive.switch.ch/index.php/s/kchZFSdzPhqHX1g). Le conoscenze acquisite potrebbero potenzialmente perfezionare gli attuali modelli di steroidigenesi fisiologica e identificare i meccanismi molecolari coinvolti nella patogenesi delle condizioni cliniche/patologiche legate agli ormoni steroidei. L'opportunità di svolgere il dottorato/dottorato di ricerca, la formazione in metodi molecolari e cellulari, team internazionale dedicato e il supporto di giovani scienziati esperti, ambiente di lavoro piacevole a Zurigo. Anfonderungen:
• Lavorare al progetto di ricerca (lavoro di laboratorio di cultura molecolare e cellulare), scrivere una dissertazione
• Il contributo ai corsi di dissezione anatomica per gli studenti vet-med è atteso
• Buon comando in inglese, disponibilità ad imparare il tedesco (se la conoscenza della lingua non è ancora disponibile)
• Il candidato di successo contribuirà all'atmosfera collaborativa con buon spirito di squadra nel laboratorio Wirbieten: I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di una vasta gamma di offerte interessanti. Per saperne di più: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

Die Gruppe der Reproduktionsbiologie des Instituts für Veterinärmedizin, Fakultät Vetsuisse, Universität Zürich www.vetanat.uzh.ch sucht einen Doktoranden für eine Doktorstelle im Bereich der vergleichenden Reproduktionsendokrinologie. Hochmotivierte, an der Reproduktionsendokrinologie interessierte Doktoranden mit vet-med-Abschluss sind willkommen, sich für diese Stelle zu bewerben. Das von der SNF (Swiss National Science Foundation) geförderte Projekt untersucht die molekularen Mechanismen von Hypoxie und HIF1α Signalisierung in steroidogenen Zellen mit Fokus auf Granulosa und Leydig Zellen. Die Steroidogenese ist ein für die Fortpflanzungsfunktion unerlässlicher, stark regulierter Prozess, dessen Dysregulation zu einer Reihe klinischer Bedingungen beiträgt, die die Gonadenaktivität beeinflussen. Hypoxie und HIF1α-vermittelte Wege sind vor kurzem als integrale Komponenten der Signalnetzwerke zur Regulierung der Steroidhormonproduktion entstanden. Neue regulatorische Mechanismen, die in unserer Forschungsgruppe beschrieben werden, betonen die Notwendigkeit weiterer Untersuchungen zur komplexen Rolle der hypoxischen Signalisierung im Steroidogenen Prozess (weitere Details siehe: https://drive.switch.ch/index.php/s/kchZFSdzPhqHX1g). Das erworbene Wissen könnte die aktuellen Modelle der physiologischen Steroidogenese weiter verfeinern und molekulare Mechanismen identifizieren, die in die Pathogenese von Steroidhormonen einfließen. Die Möglichkeit, Promotion/PhD-Arbeiten, Ausbildung in molekularen und Zellbiologie-Methoden, engagiertes internationales Team und Unterstützung erfahrener Nachwuchswissenschaftler, angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld in Zürich durchzuführen.

Aufgaben: Le Groupe de Biologie reproductive de l'Institut d'Anatomie Vétérinaire, Faculté Vetsuisse, Université de Zurich www.vetanat.uzh.ch est à la recherche d'un candidat pour un poste de doctorat dans le domaine de l'endocrinologie reproductive comparative. Les étudiants hautement motivés avec un diplôme de vet-med, intéressé par l'endocrinologie reproductive, sont invités à postuler pour ce poste. La stéroïdeogenèse est un processus étroitement réglementé essentiel pour la fonction reproductive, et sa dysrégulation contribue à une gamme de conditions cliniques affectant l'activité gonade. Les voies hypoxie et HIF1α-médiée sont récemment apparues comme des composants intégrés des réseaux de signalisation régulant la production d'hormones stéroïdes. De nouveaux mécanismes réglementaires décrits dans notre groupe de recherche soulignent la nécessité de poursuivre les recherches sur le rôle complexe de la signalisation hypoxique dans le processus stérogénique (pour plus de détails voir: https://drive.switch.ch/index.php/s/kchZFSdzPhqHX1g). Les connaissances acquises pourraient éventuellement affiner les modèles actuels de stéroïdogénèse physiologique et identifier les mécanismes moléculaires impliqués dans la pathogénèse des conditions cliniques/pathologiques liées aux hormones stéroïdes. L'opportunité d'effectuer des travaux de doctorat/PhD, la formation aux méthodes moléculaires et cellulaires-biologie, l'équipe internationale dédiée et le soutien de jeunes scientifiques expérimentés, environnement de travail agréable à Zurich. • Travailler sur le projet de recherche (travail de laboratoire de culture moléculaire et cellulaire), rédiger une déclaration
• Contribution aux cours de dissection anatomique pour les étudiants à la recherche de vet est attendu

jobs.title: Bioimage Analyst

titleByLocale.fr: Bioimage Analyste

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
The successful candidate will:

• develop OME-Zarr conversion workflows tailored to flow cytometry imaging data

• design and implement novel components for Fractal addressing common use-cases identified together with the Flow Cytometry Facility, including AI-based segmentation and morphological feature extraction

• validate the pipeline on biological applications, in close collaboration with UZH researchers

• produce high-quality documentation, tutorials, and training materials to ensure the uptake of these tools by the UZH research community

• contribute to the scientific dissemination of the work through publications, presentations, and community engagement within the Fractal and OME-Zarr ecosystems

Anforderungen:
We are looking for a motivated scientist with strong computational skills and a genuine interest in bridging advanced image analysis and biology.

Furthermore, you should bring the following qualifications:

• a master's degree or PhD in computational biology, bioinformatics, computer science, biomedical engineering, physics, or a related field

• strong programming skills in Python, including experience with scientific libraries for image analysis (e.g. scikit-image, numpy, dask) and familiarity with version control (Git)

• experience with bioimage analysis, ideally including AI-based segmentation methods

• familiarity with modern image data standards such as OME-Zarr, or a clear willingness to learn them

• experience in having mastered a biological project involving microscopy/flow cytometry data is an advantage but not required

• the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across interdisciplinary teams (computational and experimental)

• excellent communication skills in English (German is not required)

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• In collaboration with the PI of the project you will develop and carry out the project outlined above, conduct original fieldwork (qualitative interviews with headteachers and with racially and/or socio-economically minoritized students of Gymnasia in German-speaking Switzerland), data analysis (including participative data analysis workshops) and complete a doctoral dissertation (paper based dissertation).

• You will participate actively in project activities, including workshops, and international conferences, and contribute to academic and practice-oriented publications emerging from the project.

• You will contribute to teaching in the field Human Geography and to services in the Geography Teacher Training unit (GTT) at GIUZ.

• You will participate in the Zurich Graduate School in Geography & Earth System Science.

Anforderungen:
• You hold a Master's degree or are about to complete a Master's degree in geography, sociology, educational studies, youth studies, social anthropology, social work or in a closely related field.

• You have demonstrated substantial experience in qualitative research and a strong interest in questions on (in)equality and justice. Experience with participative methods is an advantage.

• You enjoy fieldwork and are interested in the views of young people.

• You are motivated to engage critically with questions of (in)equality, justice, and institutional discrimination.

• You bring strong communication and teamwork skills.

• You speak and write German and English fluently.
 Your benefits

• You will work in a stimulating and supportive research environment and be part of an SNSF research project.

• You will receive regular mentoring and support in pursuing your academic career.

• You are part of a structured doctoral program .

• You will get paid according to the salary scale of the Swiss National Science Foundation .

• You will get a personal workplace with technical equipment.

• You will be able to profit from the lively, culturally diverse and inspiring institute and campus environment, from the attractive working conditions and the manifold opportunities for further education at UZH. With around 30,000 students and 10,000 employees, UZH is the largest university in Switzerland.

• You will be able to enjoy the excellent living environment of Zurich and its surroundings that offer a broad range of cultural activities and easy access to lakes, countryside and mountains.

• Lei fa parte di un programma di dottorato strutturato.

• Lei avrà un posto di lavoro personale con attrezzature tecniche.
• Potrai trarre vantaggio dal vivace, culturalmente diversificato e stimolante ambiente di istituto e campus, dalle condizioni di lavoro attraenti e dalle molteplici opportunità di formazione continua a UZH. Con circa 30.000 studenti e 10.000 dipendenti, UZH è la più grande università in Svizzera.
• Potrai godere l'eccellente ambiente di vita di Zurigo e dei suoi dintorni che offrono una vasta gamma di attività culturali e un facile accesso a laghi, campagne e montagne. • Sie sind motiviert, sich kritisch mit Fragen der (Un-)Gleichheit, Gerechtigkeit und institutionellen Diskriminierung auseinanderzusetzen.
• Sie bringen starke Kommunikation und Teamfähigkeiten mit sich.

• Sie sind Teil eines strukturierten Promotionsprogramms.
• Sie erhalten eine Vergütung nach dem Gehaltsmaßstab der Schweizerischen Nationalfonds.
• Sie erhalten einen persönlichen Arbeitsplatz mit technischer Ausstattung.
• Sie profitieren von der lebendigen, kulturell vielfältigen und inspirierenden Instituts- und Campusumgebung, den attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen und den vielfältigen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten an der UZH. The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Process and analyse large archives of optical stereo satellite imagery.

• Develop and improve photogrammetric workflows for DSM and CHM generation.

• Generate and validate multi-temporal canopy height models.

• Analyse long-term forest structural dynamics and disturbance processes.

• Publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and present them at international conferences.

• Contribute to teaching activities within the Department of Geography.

Anforderungen:
You hold a MSc degree in photogrammetry, remote sensing, geomatics, geodesy, physical geography, environmental sciences, computer science, geoinformatics, aero/astro engineering, or a related discipline.

Experience or strong interest in at least one of the following:
• Satellite or airborne remote sensing data processing/analysis

• Stereo photogrammetry and/or SfM software (open-source or commercial)

• Very-high-resolution commercial satellite image processing and/or analysis

• Airborne LiDAR, and/or spaceborne laser altimetry (GEDI, ICESat-2) analysis

• Geospatial data processing

• Scientific programming (Python, R, Julia, or Matlab)
Other relevant, but optional experience (ideally one or more):
• Point cloud processing and/or analysis

• Computer vision and/or machine learning involving geospatial data

• Forest science

• Linux, Git/Github, Jupyter, Cloud computing

• Open-source geospatial stack (e.g., GDAL, PDAL, GeoPandas, xarray)

• Excellent written and oral communication skills (publication or other technical writing, conference poster or talk)
We offer

• A fully funded 4-year PhD position.

• Access to unique international remote sensing datasets.

• Project collaboration with leading forest and remote sensing researchers across Europe (such as WSL, TU Wien, NIBIO, and IGE Grenoble) and Canada (Canadian Forest Service).

• Excellent research infrastructure and computational resources.

• A stimulating and supportive research environment at the University of Zurich.

• Opportunity to collaborate with both remote sensing and machine learning research groups at the University of Zurich.

Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

jobs.title: Professorship of Traumatology of the Musculoskeletal System

titleByLocale.it: Professorship of Traumatology of the Musculoskeletal System
titleByLocale.en: Professorship of Traumatology of the Musculoskeletal System
titleByLocale.fr: Professeur de traumatologie du système musculosquelettique

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and 12 professional apprenticeship streams, Switzerland's largest university provides an inspiring working environment at the vanguard of research and education. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
We are looking for a dynamic, integrative, and collaborative personality, with extensive clinical expertise and scientific experience in traumatology, particularly in polytrauma research and the care of polytrauma patients. A habilitation or an equivalent academic qualification, as well as board certification in Orthopedic Surgery and Traumatology of the Musculoskeletal System, and subspecialty certification in spinal surgery or an equivalent foreign qualification, are required. Willingness to cooperate with related disciplines at USZ and the University Hospital Balgrist is expected.

As you will take on the leadership of the Department of Traumatology, you should have experience in leading or serving as deputy head of a university hospital department. In addition, you should have comprehensive experience in leading a research group, acquiring competitive third-party funding, and contributing to student teaching, supervision of academic theses, and the promotion of early-career researchers.

The University of Zurich offers exceptional conditions for cutting-edge medical research. With its four university hospitals, the University of Zurich provides access to extensive patient populations, interdisciplinary research networks, and clinical expertise across all age groups and specialties. Its proximity to ETH Zurich offers additional opportunities for collaboration in computational medicine, bioengineering, data science, and AI-driven medicine. As a result, the Zurich location offers a translational ecosystem that spans from basic research to clinical application.

German language skills at level B2 of the common European framework of reference for languages should be available or must be acquired within a reasonable period of time.
The University of Zurich is an equal opportunities employer and in particular strives to increase the percentage of women in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are encouraged to apply.

The University of Zurich sees researchers as modern leadership personalities who conduct excellent research - taking into account the Open Science principles - through their own research projects, promote excellent young researchers and who help to shape a forward-looking university with innovative research-based teaching.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers .

Als grösste Universität der Schweiz bietet die Universität Zürich eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Positionen in verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Berufsfeldern. Mit rund 10'000 Mitarbeitenden und aktuell 12 Berufsprofilen für Lernende bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in der Spitzenforschung und Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten bei uns ein. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeberin!

Aufgaben:
An der Medizinischen Fakultät der Universität Zürich ist per 1. Februar 2028 der Lehrstuhl für Neurologie neu zu besetzen. Der Lehrstuhl ist an der Klinik für Neurologie des Universitätsspitals Zürich angesiedelt und vertritt das Fach in Forschung, Versorgung und Lehre. Er ist mit der Leitung der Klinik verbunden.

Anforderungen:
Gesucht wird eine dynamische, integrative Persönlichkeit mit umfangreicher klinischer Expertise, wissenschaftlicher Exzellenz und entsprechender internationaler Visibilität. Eine Habilitation oder gleichwertige wissenschaftliche Qualifikation sowie ein Facharzttitel in Neurologie werden vorausgesetzt. Sie verfügen über ein überzeugendes Konzept für die neurologische Forschung und Lehre der Zukunft. Mögliche Forschungsschwerpunkte der Professur umfassen zum Beispiel zerebrovaskuläre Erkrankungen, die Neuroonkologie, Bewegungsstörungen, degenerative Erkrankungen und die Neuroimmunologie. Da Sie die Leitung der Klinik für Neurologie übernehmen werden, bringen Sie Leitungserfahrung mindestens auf Stufe leitender Arzt/leitende Ärztin oder leitender Oberarzt/leitende Oberärztin an einer universitären Klinik mit. Darüber hinaus verfügen Sie über umfassende Erfahrungen in der Leitung einer grösseren Forschungsgruppe, der Einwerbung von kompetitiven Drittmitteln sowie in der studentischen Lehre, der Betreuung von Qualifikationsarbeiten und der akademischen Nachwuchsförderung.

Von der erfolgreichen Kandidatin oder dem erfolgreichen Kandidaten wird erwartet, die bestehenden sowie neue Kooperationen innerhalb des Spitals und mit anderen Forschungseinrichtungen zu stärken. Insbesondere wird eine Vernetzung und Weiterentwicklung des bestehenden Klinischen Neurozentrums mit den Kliniken für Neurochirurgie und Neuroradiologie erwartet.

Die Universität Zürich bietet aussergewöhnliche Bedingungen für Spitzenforschung in der Medizin. Mit ihren vier universitären Spitälern eröffnet sie Zugang zu umfassenden Patientenpopulationen, interdisziplinären Forschungsnetzwerken und klinischer Expertise über alle Altersgruppen und Fachbereiche hinweg. Aufgrund der räumlichen Nähe zur ETH Zürich bestehen zusätzliche Möglichkeiten zu Kooperationen in Computational Medicine, Bioengineering, Data Science und KI-gestützter Medizin. Damit bietet der Standort Zürich ein translational ausgerichtetes Ökosystem, das von der Grundlagenforschung bis zur klinischen Anwendung reicht. Das Zentrum für Neurowissenschaften (ZNZ) bietet hervorragende Möglichkeiten zur Vernetzung mit grundlagenorientierten neurowissenschaftlichen Gruppen an der Universität Zürich und der ETH Zürich.

Deutschkenntnisse auf Niveau B2 des gemeinsamen europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen sollten vorhanden sein oder müssen innert nützlicher Frist erworben werden.

Die Universität Zürich ist bestrebt, den Anteil von Frauen in Führungspositionen zu erhöhen. Daher werden qualifizierte Forscherinnen ausdrücklich aufgefordert, sich zu bewerben.

Die Universität Zürich versteht Forschende als moderne Führungspersönlichkeiten, die exzellente Forschung – unter der Berücksichtigung der Open Science-Grundsätze – durch eigene Forschungsprojekte wie auch die Förderung von exzellenten Nachwuchsforschenden betreiben und die mit innovativer forschungsbasierter Lehre eine zukunftsorientierte Universität mitgestalten.

Wir bieten:
Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von vielfältigen und attraktiven Angeboten .

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Università di Zurigo, la più grande università della Svizzera, offre una vasta gamma di posizioni interessanti in vari campi di studio e carriera. Con circa 10.000 dipendenti e attualmente 12 profili professionali per i lavoratori, l'Università offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante nella ricerca e nell'istruzione di alto livello. Utilizzate con noi il vostro talento e le vostre competenze. Learn più circa l'UZH come datore di lavoro! Compiti: La cattedra di neurologia deve essere riconfermata presso la Facoltà di Medicina dell'Università di Zurigo a partire dal 1 febbraio 2028. La cattedra si trova presso il Dipartimento di Neurologia dell'Ospedale universitario di Zurigo e rappresenta il soggetto in ricerca, cura e insegnamento. E' collegata con il capo della clinica.
• Requisiti: Una personalità dinamica, di Hanno un concetto convincente per la ricerca e l'insegnamento futuristica del diploma. Le possibili aree di ricerca della cattedra includono malattie cerebrovascolare, neurooncologia, disturbi del movimento, malattie degenerative e neuroimmunologia. Come si assumerà la gestione della neurologia Clinica, si porterà esperienza di gestione almeno al livello di un medico senior o medico/conduttore senior presso una clinica universitaria. Inoltre, hai una vasta esperienza nella gestione di un gruppo di ricerca più ampio, nell'assunzione di fondi terzi competitivi, nonché nell'insegnamento dello studente, nella supervisione del lavoro di qualificazione e nella promozione di giovani accademici. Il candidato di successo dovrebbe rafforzare la cooperazione esistente e nuova all'interno dell'ospedale e con altri istituti di ricerca. In particolare, il Neurocentro Clinico esistente dovrebbe essere collegato e ulteriormente sviluppato con i Centri di Neurochirurgia e Neuroradiologia Clinici. L'Università di Zurigo offre condizioni eccezionali per la ricerca di alto livello in medicina. Con i suoi quattro ospedali universitari, apre l'accesso a popolazioni di pazienti complete, reti di ricerca interdisciplinare e competenze cliniche in tutte le fasce di età e discipline. Grazie alla vicinanza con l'ETH di Zurigo, esistono ulteriori opportunità di cooperazione in medicina Computazionale, bioingegneria, scienza dei dati e medicina con l'AI. Il sito di Zurigo offre così un ecosistema orientato verso l'alto, dalla ricerca di base all'applicazione clinica. Le competenze linguistiche tedesche al livello B2 del Quadro comune europeo di riferimento per le lingue dovrebbero essere disponibili o devono essere acquisite entro un periodo utile. L'Università di Zurigo si impegna ad aumentare la percentuale di donne in posizioni di leadership. L'Università di Zurigo vede i ricercatori come leader moderni che svolgono un'eccellente ricerca.Tenendo conto dei principi scientifici aperti... attraverso i propri progetti di ricerca, nonché la promozione di giovani ricercatori eccellenti e che aiutano a formare un'università orientata al futuro con un insegnamento innovativo basato sulla ricerca.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As the largest university in Switzerland, the University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various fields of study and career. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional profiles for learners, the University offers an inspiring working environment in top research and education. Use your talent and skills with us. Learn more about the UZH as an employer! Tasks: The Chair of Neurology is to be re-appointed at the Medical Faculty of the University of Zurich as of 1 February 2028. The chair is located at the Department of Neurology of the University Hospital Zurich and represents the subject in research, care and teaching. It is connected with the head of the clinic.
• Requirements: A dynamic, integrative personality with extensive clinical expertise, scientific excellence and corresponding international visibility is sought. Habilitation or equivalent scientific qualification as well as a specialist title in neurology are required. They have a convincing concept for neurological research and teaching of the future. Possible research areas of the professorship include cerebrovascular diseases, neurooncology, movement disorders, degenerative diseases and neuroimmunology. As you will take over the management of the Neurology Clinic, you will bring management experience at least at the level of a senior physician or senior physician/conductor at a university clinic. In addition, you have extensive experience in the management of a larger research group, the recruitment of competitive third-party funds as well as in the teaching of the student, the supervision of qualification work and the promotion of young academics. The successful candidate is expected to strengthen the existing and new cooperation within the hospital and with other research institutions. In particular, the existing Clinical Neurocenter is expected to be connected and further developed with the Neurosurgery and Neuroradiology Clinics. The University of Zurich offers exceptional conditions for top-level research in medicine. With its four universitary hospitals, it opens up access to comprehensive patient populations, interdisciplinary research networks and clinical expertise across all age groups and disciplines. Due to the proximity to ETH Zurich, additional opportunities exist for cooperation in Comp-utational Medicine, Bio-engineering, Data Science and AI-supported medicine. Thus, the Zurich site offers a gestalt-oriented ecosystem, ranging from basic research to clinical application. The Center for Neuroscience (ZNZ) offers excellent opportunities for networking with basic neuroscience groups at the University of Zurich and ETH Zurich. German language skills at level B2 of the common European Framework of Reference for Languages should be available or must be acquired within a useful period. The University of Zurich is committed to increasing the proportion of women in leadership positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are expressly invited to apply. The University of Zurich sees researchers as modern leaders who conduct excellent research – taking into account the open science principles – through their own research projects as well as the promotion of excellent young researchers and who help shape a future-oriented university with innovative research-based teaching.
• We offer: Our employees benefit from diverse and attractive offers.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que plus grande université de Suisse, l'Université de Zurich offre une large gamme de postes attrayants dans différents domaines d'études et de carrière. Avec environ 10 000 employés et actuellement 12 profils professionnels pour les apprenants, l'Université offre un environnement de travail inspirant dans la recherche et l'éducation de haut niveau. Utilisez vos talents et compétences avec nous. En savoir plus sur l'UZH en tant qu'employeur! Tâches: La Chaire de neurologie doit être réembauchée à la Faculté de médecine de l'Université de Zurich à partir du 1er février 2028. La chaire est située au département de neurologie de l'hôpital universitaire de Zurich et représente le sujet de la recherche, des soins et de l'enseignement. Elle est liée au chef de la clinique.
• Exigences : Une personnalité dynamique et intégrative avec une vaste expertise clinique, l'excellence scientifique et la visibilité internationale correspondante est recherchée. Ils ont un concept convaincant pour la recherche neurologique et l'enseignement de l'avenir. Les domaines de recherche possibles du professeur comprennent les maladies cérébrovasculaires, neurooncologie, troubles du mouvement, maladies dégénératives et neuroimmunologie. Lorsque vous prendrez en charge la gestion de la clinique de neurologie, vous apporterez une expérience de gestion au moins au niveau d'un médecin ou médecin/conducteur senior dans une clinique universitaire. En outre, vous avez une vaste expérience dans la gestion d'un groupe de recherche plus vaste, le recrutement de fonds tiers concurrentiels ainsi que dans l'enseignement de l'étudiant, la supervision du travail de qualification et la promotion des jeunes universitaires. Le candidat retenu devrait renforcer la coopération existante et nouvelle au sein de l'hôpital et avec d'autres établissements de recherche. En particulier, le Neurocentre clinique existant devrait être connecté et développé avec les cliniques de neurochirurgie et de neuroradiologie. L'Université de Zurich offre des conditions exceptionnelles pour la recherche de haut niveau en médecine. Avec ses quatre hôpitaux universels, il ouvre l'accès à des populations de patients complètes, des réseaux de recherche interdisciplinaires et une expertise clinique dans tous les groupes d'âge et disciplines. Grâce à la proximité de l'ETH Zurich, il existe d'autres possibilités de coopération en médecine computationnelle, bioingénierie, Data Science et en médecine assistée par l'IA. Ainsi, le site Zurich offre un écosystème orienté gestalt, allant de la recherche fondamentale à l'application clinique. Le Centre de Neuroscience (ZNZ) offre d'excellentes opportunités de réseautage avec des groupes de neurosciences de base à l'Université de Zurich et l'ETH Zurich. Les compétences linguistiques allemandes au niveau B2 du Cadre européen commun de référence pour les langues devraient être disponibles ou doivent être acquises dans un délai utile. L'Université de Zurich s'engage à augmenter la proportion de femmes occupant des postes de direction. L'Université de Zurich voit les chercheurs comme des leaders modernes qui mènent d'excellentes recherches – en tenant compte des principes scientifiques ouverts – à travers leurs propres projets de recherche ainsi que la promotion d'excellents jeunes chercheurs et qui contribuent à façonner une université tournée vers l'avenir avec un enseignement innovant basé sur la recherche.

Tâches: Personnalité dynamique, intégrative et coopérative avec une vaste expertise clinique et une expérience scientifique en traumatologie, en particulier la recherche sur les polytraumatismes et les soins du patient polytrauma :inside. Un AGE ou une qualification scientifique équivalente et un titre spécialisé en chirurgie orthopédique et traumatologie du système musculosquelettique ainsi que le titre principal pour la chirurgie médullaire ou une qualification étrangère équivalente sont requis. La volonté de coopérer avec les cliniques affiliées à l'USZ et l'hôpital universitaire de Balgrist est attendue. Comme vous prendrez en charge la gestion de la clinique de traumatologie, vous aurez de l'expérience dans la gestion ou la gestion adjointe d'une clinique universelle. De plus, vous aurez une vaste expérience dans la gestion d'un groupe de recherche, le recrutement de fonds tiers concurrentiels ainsi que dans l'enseignement de l'étudiant, la supervision du travail de qualification et la promotion de jeunes universitaires. jobs.title: Professorship of Neurology

titleByLocale.fr: Professorship of Neurology

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and 12 professional apprenticeship streams, Switzerland's largest university provides an inspiring working environment at the vanguard of research and education. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
We seek a dynamic and inclusive leader with outstanding clinical expertise, a distinguished scientific track record, and strong international recognition, who can articulate a compelling vision for the future of neurological research and education. Applicants must hold a habilitation (or equivalent qualification) and board certification in neurology. Relevant research areas may include, but are not limited to, cerebrovascular diseases, neurooncology, movement disorders, neurodegenerative diseases, and neuroimmunology. Candidates should demonstrate leadership experience at the level of senior physician or senior attending physician at a university hospital. A proven ability to lead large research teams, secure competitive third-party funding, and contribute to teaching at all levels-including student instruction, thesis supervision, and the mentorship of early-career researchers-is essential.

The appointee is expected to strengthen existing collaborations within the hospital and with external research institutions. In particular, the role involves fostering interdisciplinary collaboration and further developing the existing Clinical Neuroscience Center in close partnership with the Department of Neurosurgery and the Department of Neuroradiology.

The University of Zurich offers exceptional conditions for cutting-edge medical research. With its four university hospitals, the University of Zurich provides access to extensive patient populations, interdisciplinary research networks, and clinical expertise across all age groups and specialties. Its proximity to ETH Zurich offers additional opportunities for collaboration in computational medicine, bioengineering, data science, and AI-driven medicine. As a result, the Zurich location offers a translational ecosystem that spans from basic re-search to clinical application. The Neuroscience Center Zurich (ZNZ) provides excellent opportunities for networking with basic neuroscience groups at the University of Zurich and ETH Zurich.

German language skills at level B2 of the common European framework of reference for languages should be available or must be acquired within a reasonable period of time.

The University of Zurich is an equal opportunities employer and in particular strives to increase the percentage of women in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are encouraged to apply.

The University of Zurich sees researchers as modern leadership personalities who conduct excellent research - taking into account the Open Science principles - through their own research projects, promote excellent young researchers and who help to shape a forward-looking university with innovative research-based teaching.

jobs.title: Staff Mass Spectrometrist

titleByLocale.fr: Spectrométriste de masse du personnel

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• You operate and maintain the mass spectrometry infrastructure, including Orbitrap Astral instruments and supporting LC systems, ensuring consistently high performance.

• Coordination, preparation, and processing of biological samples for stable isotope tracing, metabolomics, epitranscriptomics, and other MS-omics analyses - including low-input and single-cell samples - are part of your responsibilities.

• You support the implementation of automated sample preparation pipelines to increase throughput and improve reproducibility.

• Hands-on guidance and training of students and postdocs in the use of the instruments is an important part of your role.

• You actively contribute to the development and optimization of LC-MS methods for metabolite quantification, isotope enrichment, lipid profiling, and modified nucleotides.

• Routine instrument calibration, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance are carried out by you independently.

• You support data acquisition as well as initial QC and processing pipelines.

• You perform MS data processing and analysis across applications and collaborative projects, ensuring high data quality and consistency.

• You manage MS data across projects to ensure traceability, organization, and -reproducibility.

• You also help manage consumables, sample logistics, and platform documentation.

Anforderungen:
• Expert (MSc or PhD) in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, or a related field

• Solid practical experience with LC-MS/MS - ideally on Orbitrap-based instruments

• Background in stable isotope tracing and/or metabolomics in a biological setting is strongly preferred

• Interest in or experience with laboratory automation - liquid handling, automated sample prep, or scripted workflows

• Curiosity about emerging technologies, particularly single-cell mass spectrometry, is a genuine plus

• Methodical, detail-oriented, and comfortable troubleshooting complex instrument issues

• Able to work independently and communicate clearly with researchers at all levels

• Experience in a core facility, CRO, or research lab environment is valued

• English required; German is a plus

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la Spectrométrie de Masse

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• You will lead the day-to-day operations of the MS platform, including scheduling, quality control and sample throughput across metabolomics, isotope tracing and other MS-omics workflows.

• In this role, you drive method development for LC-MS/MS-based stable isotope tracing, metabolomics, RNA modifications and lipid analysis, including applications to in vivo and patient-derived samples.

• You ensure high data quality, robust data management and fully reproducible workflows through rigorous QC and precise documentation.

• You will co-develop and implement automated sample preparation workflows to increase throughput and improve reproducibility.

• Co-design of the data acquisition and processing infrastructure around Orbitrap Astral instruments will be part of your responsibilities.

• You maintain mass spectrometry instruments at the highest performance standards and manage service contracts as well as consumables.

• Contribution to the development of single-cell mass spectrometry methods is expected as part of the lab's technology development agenda.

• You actively contribute to research projects, from experimental planning and data interpretation through to manuscript writing.

• Training and mentoring of graduate students, postdocs, and collaborators in MS techniques and experimental design is an important part of your work.

• You advise on and support the procurement of future equipment and contribute to grant applications for infrastructure funding.

• You represent the platform in internal and external collaborations across the Zurich life sciences community.

Anforderungen:
• Expert (MSc or PhD) in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, or a closely related field - with a strong mass spectrometry track record; Experience matters

• Hands-on expertise with high-resolution LC-MS platforms, ideally including Orbitrap-based instruments

• Proven experience in stable isotope tracing and/or metabolomics in a biological research context - this is central to the lab's work

• Demonstrated ability to develop and optimize analytical methods from first principles
 Experience with or strong interest in laboratory automation - liquid handling systems, automated sample prep, or workflow scripting
• Interest in or experience with single-cell mass spectrometry technologies is a plus

• Experience mentoring or teaching MS techniques to non-specialists

• Strong publication record showing independent scientific contributions

• Experience running or co-running a core or research facility is a strong plus, not prerequisite

• Fluent in English; German is an asset but not required

• Il contributo attivo ai progetti di ricerca, dalla pianificazione sperimentale e l'interpretazione dei dati fino alla scrittura manoscritta.
• Formazione e AMENTO DI GRATUITI, POSTDOC e 1100 R nelle tecniche SM e nella progettazione sperimentale è una parte importante del vostro lavoro.

• Esperienza di proven in tracciatura isotopo stabile e/o metabolomica in un contesto di ricerca biologica - questo è fondamentale per il lavoro del laboratorio
• Capacità dimostrativa di sviluppare e ottimizzare metodi analitici dai primi principi Esperienza con o forte interesse per l'automazione di laboratorio - sistemi di gestione del liquido, campione automatizzato Prep, o scripting
• L'interesse o l'esperienza con le tecnologie di spettrometria di massa a cellule singole è un plus
• L'esperienza di mentoring o di insegnamento tecniche SM a non specialisti
• Forte record di pubblicazione che mostra contributi scientifici indipendenti
• L'esperienza di esecuzione o co-esecuzione di un nucleo o di una struttura di ricerca è un forte plus, non prerequisito

jobs.title: Senior AI Engagement Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable principal de la mobilisation en matière d'IA

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Act as a high-credibility external representative of UZH.ai in the Swiss and European AI ecosystem (federal and cantonal actors, funding agencies, startup hubs, industry associations, international AI initiatives).

• Map and regularly update UZH.ai on strategically relevant AI policy processes, funding programmes, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives (Swiss, EU, international), highlighting concrete opportunities and risks.

• Represent UZH and coordinate its presence at key AI policy events, working groups, and ecosystem fora (digitalswitzerland, federal AI groups, Geneva AI governance fora, etc.)

• Lead preparation and delivery of UZH's engagement at high-profile events such as the Global AI Summit 2027 (programme contributions, side events, delegation, and messaging), together with UZH leadership and the Digital Strategy Board.

• Identify and orchestrate UZH participation in large AI consortia and infrastructure initiatives (including “CERN-for-AI”-type proposals), coordinating faculty contributions internally.

• Drive 2–3 priority external funding applications per year, leading the political, ecosystem, and stake-holder-engagement components in collaboration with PIs, UZH.ai, DSI, and the UZH Research Office.

• Provide short, structured, and occasionally time-critical briefings to the Digital Strategy Board and UZH leadership, including clear recommendations.

• Support UZH.ai's positioning in national and international AI collaborations with other universities, public bodies, and industry.

Anforderungen:
We are looking for a Senior AI Engagement Lead to act as a highly credible, externally visible figurehead for UZH.ai in the Swiss AI ecosystem and key international fora. You will operate at the interface of academia, startups, industry, and policy-making, using your personal track record and network to open doors, build alliances, and help position UZH as a shaping voice in AI strategy, funding, and ecosystem development.
This is not a communications role. You will operate at the interface of academia, policy, and the AI ecosystem: building relationships with federal and cantonal actors, international AI initiatives, and funding bodies; preparing UZH's presence at key AI policy fora including the Global AI Summit 2027; and driving a pipeline of external grants and consortia. You are motivated by impact on the ecosystem and public good and will work closely with the UZH.ai Project Lead, the Digital Strategy Board, and UZH leadership.
Typical backgrounds we are particularly interested in:
• UZH (or other Swiss university) alumni who have founded, scaled, and successfully exited a tech startup, and now want to give back to the Swiss AI ecosystem.

• Senior ecosystem or policy leaders with 10–15+ years of relevant experience who wish to take on a strategic, part-time role alongside other activities.

• Master's degree or PhD, ideally from UZH or another Swiss university, in a relevant field (e.g. computer science, data science, engineering, economics, law, political science).
 Either:
• You have founded and scaled a tech or AI-related startup and successfully exited (trade sale, IPO, or equivalent), or

• You have at least 10–15 years of experience in senior roles in AI-related policy, ecosystem development, strategic stakeholder engagement, or research/innovation funding.

• A strong personal network in Swiss and/or European AI policy, government, research funding, and/or startup and innovation circles, with a track record of using that network to get things done.

• Deep understanding of how government policies, regulation, and funding instruments influence startup and scale-up success, ideally based on your own founder or investor experience.

• Proven ability to operate in politically sensitive, multi-stakeholder environments: you can align interests, negotiate trade-offs, and quietly unlock solutions without damaging relationships.

• Credible independent voice: you are comfortable representing UZH in senior fora, shaping narratives, and saying “no” when needed.

• Strategic and structured working style: you prioritise for impact, communicate clearly in writing and speech, and deliver without micro-management.

• Familiarity with Swiss higher education and research funding structures is a strong asset.

• Genuine motivation to strengthen the AI ecosystem in Switzerland and to support excellent, responsible AI research.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Università di Zurigo, la più grande università della Svizzera, offre una gamma di posizioni attraenti in varie aree tematiche e campi professionali. Con circa 10.000 dipendenti e attualmente 12 corsi di apprendistato professionale, l'Università offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante sulla ricerca all'avanguardia e sull'istruzione di prima classe. Metti il tuo talento e le tue capacità per lavorare con noi. Scopri di più su UZH come datore di lavoro! Aufgaben:
• Atto come rappresentante esterno ad alta fattibilità dell'UZH.ai nell'ecosistema dell'AI svizzero ed europeo (attori federali e cantonali, agenzie di finanziamento, hub di startup, associazioni di settore, iniziative AI internazionali).
• Mappa e aggiorna regolarmente UZH.ai sui processi strategici di policy AI, programmi di finanziamento e iniziative infrastrutturali su larga scala (Swiss, EU, international), evidenziando opportunità e rischi concreti.
• Rappresentare UZH e coordinare la sua presenza in importanti eventi politici AI, gruppi di lavoro e fora di ecosistema (digitalswitzerland, gruppi di AI federali, Ginevra AI governance fora, ecc.)
• Preparazione e consegna del coinvolgimento di UZH in eventi di alto profilo come il Global AI Summit 2027 (contributi di programma, eventi collaterali, delegazione e messaggistica), insieme alla leadership UZH e il Digital Strategy Board.
• Identificare e orchestrare la partecipazione UZH a grandi consorzi AI e iniziative infrastrutturali (comprese le proposte di tipo “CERN-for-AI”), coordinando i contributi docenti internamente.
• Guidare le applicazioni di finanziamento esterno prioritarie 2–3 all'anno, guidando i componenti politici, ecosistemici e azionisti in collaborazione con PIs, UZH.ai, DSI e l'UZH Research Office.
• Fornire brevi, strutturati e occasionalmente briefing critico-tempo per il Digital Strategy Board e la leadership UZH, comprese le raccomandazioni chiare.
• Sostenere il posizionamento di UZH.ai in collaborazioni AI nazionali e internazionali con altre università, enti pubblici e industria. Anforderungen: Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior AI Engagement Lead ad agire come figurahead altamente credibile ed esteriormente visibile per UZH.ai nell'ecosistema dell'IA svizzera e fora internazionale chiave. Potrai operare all'interfaccia di accademia, startup, industria e policy-making, utilizzando il tuo record personale di traccia e rete per aprire porte, costruire alleanze, e aiutare a posizionare UZH come voce di modellazione nella strategia di AI, il finanziamento e lo sviluppo dell'ecosistema. Questo non è un ruolo di comunicazione. Potrai operare all'interfaccia dell'accademia, della politica e dell'ecosistema dell'AI: costruire relazioni con attori federali e cantonali, iniziative internazionali dell'IA e organismi di finanziamento; preparare la presenza dell'UZH nella politica chiave dell'AI fora tra cui il Global AI Summit 2027; e guidare una pipeline di sovvenzioni esterne e consorzi. Sei motivato dall'impatto sull'ecosistema e sul bene pubblico e lavorerai a stretto contatto con il Project Lead UZH.ai, il Digital Strategy Board e la leadership UZH. Sfondi tipici siamo particolarmente interessati a:
• UZH (o altre università svizzere) ex alunni che hanno fondato, scalato e uscito con successo da una startup tecnologica, e ora vogliono restituire all'ecosistema svizzero AI.
• Senior ecosistema o leader politici con 10-15 anni di esperienza rilevante che desiderano assumere un ruolo strategico e part-time insieme ad altre attività.
• Laurea magistrale o dottorato, idealmente da UZH o un'altra università svizzera, in un campo rilevante (ad esempio informatica, scienza dei dati, ingegneria, economia, diritto, scienze politiche). O:
• Hai fondato e scalato una startup legata alla tecnologia o all'intelligenza artificiale e sei uscito con successo (vendita commerciale, IPO, o equivalente), o
• Hai almeno 10–15 anni di esperienza nei ruoli senior nella politica legata all'intelligenza artificiale, nello sviluppo degli ecosistemi, nell'impegno strategico delle parti interessate o nel finanziamento della ricerca/innovazione.
• Una forte rete personale nella politica dell'AI svizzera e/o europea, nel governo, nel finanziamento della ricerca e/o nei circoli di startup e innovazione, con un track record di utilizzo di quella rete per fare le cose.
• La profonda comprensione di come le politiche governative, la regolamentazione e gli strumenti di finanziamento influenzano il successo di startup e scale-up, idealmente basato sulla propria esperienza di fondatore o investitore.
• Prove capacità di operare in ambienti politicamente sensibili e multi-stakeholder: è possibile allineare gli interessi, negoziare i trade-off e sbloccare tranquillamente soluzioni senza relazioni dannose.
• Voce indipendente credibile: sei comodo rappresentare UZH in fora senior, modellare narrazioni, e dire “no” quando necessario.
• Stile di lavoro strategico e strutturato: priorità per l'impatto, comunicare chiaramente per iscritto e discorso, e consegnare senza microgestione.
• La familiarità con le strutture svizzere di istruzione superiore e di finanziamento della ricerca è un bene forte.
• Motivazione genuina per rafforzare l'ecosistema AI in Svizzera e per sostenere la ricerca AI eccellente e responsabile. Wir bieten: I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di una vasta gamma di offerte interessanti. Maggiori informazioni: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html

• Agir en tant que représentant externe de haute crédibilité de l'UZH.ai dans l'écosystème suisse et européen de l'IA (acteurs fédéraux et cantonaux, agences de financement, centres de démarrage, associations industrielles, initiatives internationales de l'IA).
• Planifier et mettre à jour régulièrement UZH.ai sur les processus stratégiques pertinents en matière de politique d'IA, les programmes de financement et les initiatives d'infrastructure à grande échelle (Suisse, UE, international), en mettant en évidence les possibilités et les risques concrets.
• Représenter l'UZH et coordonner sa présence lors d'événements stratégiques clés sur l'IA, de groupes de travail et de forums sur les écosystèmes (numériqueswitzerland, groupes d'IA fédéraux, forums de gouvernance de Genève sur l'IA, etc.)
• Diriger la préparation et l'exécution de l'engagement de l'UZH lors d'événements très médiatisés tels que le Sommet mondial de l'IA 2027 (contributions au programme, manifestations parallèles, délégation et messagerie), ainsi que les dirigeants de l'UZH et le Conseil de stratégie numérique.
• Identifier et orchestrer la participation de l'UZH à de grands consortiums d'IA et à des initiatives d'infrastructure (y compris des propositions de type CERN pour l'AI), en coordonnant les contributions du corps professoral en interne.
• Diriger 2 à 3 demandes de financement externe prioritaires par année, en dirigeant les composantes politiques, écosystémiques et d'engagement des intervenants, en collaboration avec les IP, UZH.ai, DSI et le Bureau de recherche de l'UZH.
• Fournir des séances d'information brèves, structurées et parfois critiques sur le temps au Conseil de stratégie numérique et aux dirigeants de l'UZH, y compris des recommandations claires.
• Soutenir le positionnement d'UZH.ai dans les collaborations nationales et internationales avec d'autres universités, organismes publics et industrie. - C'est pas vrai. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Senior AI Engagement Lead pour agir comme une figure de choix hautement crédible et visible pour UZH.ai dans l'écosystème suisse de l'IA et des forums internationaux clés. Vous travaillerez à l'interface du monde universitaire, des start-up, de l'industrie et de l'élaboration des politiques, en utilisant vos antécédents personnels et votre réseau pour ouvrir des portes, construire des alliances et aider à positionner l'UZH comme une voix modelante dans la stratégie d'IA, le financement et le développement des écosystèmes. Ce n'est pas un rôle de communication. Vous travaillerez à l'interface des universités, des politiques et de l'écosystème de l'IA : établir des relations avec les acteurs fédéraux et cantonaux, les initiatives internationales de l'IA et les organismes de financement; préparer la présence de l'UZH à des forums clés de l'IA, y compris le Sommet mondial de l'IA 2027; et conduire un pipeline de subventions et de consortiums externes. Vous êtes motivé par l'impact sur l'écosystème et le bien public et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le responsable du projet UZH.ai, le Conseil de la stratégie numérique et le leadership de l'UZH. Contextes typiques qui nous intéressent particulièrement :
• Les diplômés de l'UZH (ou autre université suisse) qui ont fondé, mis à l'échelle et quitté avec succès une startup technologique, veulent maintenant redonner à l'écosystème suisse de l'IA.
• Chefs de file en matière d'écosystème ou de politiques ayant plus de 10 à 15 ans d'expérience pertinente qui souhaitent jouer un rôle stratégique à temps partiel en plus d'autres activités.
• Maîtrise ou doctorat, idéalement de l'UZH ou d'une autre université suisse, dans un domaine pertinent (p. ex. informatique, data science, ingénierie, économie, droit, sciences politiques). Soit:
• Vous avez fondé et mis à l'échelle une startup liée à la technologie ou à l'IA et avez réussi à sortir (vente commerciale, IPO ou équivalent), ou
• Vous disposez d'au moins 10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans les rôles supérieurs dans les politiques liées à l'IA, le développement des écosystèmes, la participation des intervenants stratégiques ou le financement de la recherche et de l'innovation.
• Un solide réseau personnel dans la politique suisse et/ou européenne de l'IA, le gouvernement, le financement de la recherche, et/ou les cercles de démarrage et d'innovation, avec une expérience d'utilisation de ce réseau pour faire les choses.
• Compréhension approfondie de la façon dont les politiques gouvernementales, la réglementation et les instruments de financement influencent le succès de démarrage et d'expansion, idéalement basée sur votre propre expérience de fondateur ou d'investisseur.
• Capacité éprouvée d'opérer dans des environnements politiquement sensibles et multipartites : vous pouvez aligner les intérêts, négocier des compromis et débloquer des solutions tranquillement sans nuire aux relations.
• Voix indépendante crédible : vous êtes à l'aise pour représenter l'UZH dans les forums seniors, façonner des narrations, et dire "no" au besoin.
• Style de travail stratégique et structuré : vous priorisez l'impact, vous communiquez clairement par écrit et par la parole, et vous livrez sans microgestion.
• La connaissance des structures suisses d'enseignement supérieur et de financement de la recherche est un atout important.
• Véritable motivation à renforcer l'écosystème de l'IA en Suisse et à soutenir une recherche excellente et responsable sur l'IA. - Oui. Nos employés bénéficient d'un large éventail d'offres attrayantes. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

Mit rund 10'000 Mitarbeitenden und aktuell 12 Berufsprofilen für Lernende bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in der Spitzenforschung und Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten bei uns ein. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeberin!

Aufgaben:
In dieser neu geschaffenen Funktion unterstützen Sie die Weiterentwicklung der Führungs-, Priorisierungs- und Koordinationsprozesse von Global Affairs. Sie unterstützen die Abteilungsleitung dabei, Mandate, Projekte und Ressourcen entlang der festgelegten Prioritäten auszurichten und deren koordinierte und effektive Umsetzung sicherzustellen. Die Funktion schafft Transparenz über laufende Aktivitäten, unterstützt Priorisierungsentscheidungen und sorgt für verlässliche Arbeits- und Umsetzungsstandards innerhalb der Abteilung.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:
•	Sicherstellung des Überblicks über Mandate, Projekte, Schnittstellen und Ressourcenbedarfe innerhalb der Abteilung
•	Aufbereitung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen zu Prioritäten, Kapazitäten und Ressourceneinsatz in enger Abstimmung mit der Leitung und stellvertretenden Leitung von Global Affairs
•	Koordination des Projektpools entlang der definierten Prioritäten und verfügbaren Kapazitäten
•	Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Verankerung von Standards für Planung, Reporting, Follow-ups und Projektumsetzung
•	Mitverantwortung für die Steuerung ausgewählter operativer und projektbezogener Bereiche, einschliesslich Linienverantwortung für definierte Teil der Abteilungsstruktur
•	Mitverantwortung an der Weiterentwicklung von Führungsroutinen, Koordinationsmechanismen und Ressourcenmanagement innerhalb von Global Affairs
•	Unterstützung einer wirksamen Umsetzung wiederkehrender Aktivitäten, von Projektarbeit und bereichsübergreifenden Initiativen in einem komplexen und dynamischen organisatorischen Umfeld

Anforderungen:
Gesucht ist eine erfahrene Fachperson mit ausgeprägtem Urteilsvermögen, sehr guten organisatorischen Fähigkeiten und hoher Sicherheit im Umgang mit komplexen und dynamischen Arbeitskontexten. Sie behalten auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick und können zwischen strategischen Fragestellungen, Koordinationsaufgaben und operativer Umsetzung sicher wechseln. Vorausgesetzt werden zudem eine strukturierte und verlässliche Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, Klarheit zu schaffen, wo sich Prioritäten, Prozesse und Erwartungen weiterentwickeln und über ein breites Portfolio hinweg abgestimmt werden müssen.

Idealerweise bringen Sie mit:
•	mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Funktion als Leitung Operations / Stabsleitung, Operations Lead, im Programmmanagement, in der Organisationsentwicklung oder in einer vergleichbaren managementnahen Unterstützungs- oder Steuerungsfunktion
•	fundierte Erfahrung in der Portfolioübersicht, der Priorisierung, der Ressourcensteuerung sowie in der Koordination mehrerer paralleler Arbeitsstränge
•	ausgeprägte Kompetenzen im Projekt-, Prozess- und Umsetzungsmanagement, verbunden mit der Fähigkeit, praxistaugliche Standards und Routinen einzuführen und nachhaltig zu verankern
•	Erfahrung in der Linienführung und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Komplexität, wechselnden Anforderungen und organisationalem Wandel
•	ein sehr gutes Urteilsvermögen und Gespür für Timing, insbesondere hinsichtlich der Frage, welche Themen direkt bearbeitet werden können und wo Abstimmung erforderlich ist
•	sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen auf verschiedenen Ebenen professionell zu interagieren
•	idealerweise Erfahrung in Hochschulen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder in ähnlich komplexen institutionellen Kontexten

Persönlich überzeugen Sie durch Pragmatismus, Durchsetzungsvermögen, Belastbarkeit und hoher Verlässlichkeit. Sie fühlen sich wohl in einer Rolle, die sowohl Struktur als auch Flexibilität verlangt, und bringen die nötige Souveränität mit, um Fokus zu wahren, Fortschritt zu ermöglichen und wirksame Formen der Zusammenarbeit in einem kollegialen Umfeld mitzugestalten. Gleichzeitig schätzen Sie Professionalität, Teamorientierung und einen guten Sinn für Humor im Arbeitsalltag.

Wir bieten Ihnen eine vielseitige und abwechslungsreiche Funktion in einem jungen und engagierten Team am Puls einer der führenden Universitäten Europas. Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von internationalem Hochschulwesen, institutioneller Strategie, Organisationsentwicklung und operativer Führung. Die Funktion bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, an der Weiterentwicklung von Global Affairs mitzuwirken und mitzugestalten, wie die Abteilung als koordiniertes und zukunftsorientiertes System arbeitet.
